description: This file defines the 'Image' class within the OpenCart system, providing functionalities for image manipulation such as resizing, cropping, rotating, watermarking, saving, and retrieving image properties. It handles images in various formats (GIF, PNG, JPEG, WEBP) and is part of the image processing library of the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: A class for handling image operations such as resizing, cropping, saving, watermarking, and format conversion within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Image object by loading image info and image resource based on file type.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the file path of the image.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image resource or object.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: getBits
methods.description: Returns the bit depth of the image.

methods.name: getMime
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current image resource to a specified file with a given quality.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the image to specified width and height, optionally maintaining aspect ratio based on default parameter.

methods.name: watermark
methods.description: Applies a watermark image onto the current image at a specified position.

methods.name: crop
methods.description: Crops the image to specified rectangle.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates the image by a specified degree.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies a filter to the image (private method).

methods.name: text
methods.description: Adds text to the image (private method).

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another image onto this image at specified coordinates (private method).

methods.name: html2rgb
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an RGB array (private method).
